checks.fact: Time Stamped DTM archive contains site-specific surveys since 1998.
Some areas have multiple survey epochs.
Time Stamped DTM is distributed as GeoTIFF rasters.
Tiles are packaged in 5 km zip files.
Vertical reference is Ordnance Survey Newlyn.
Data is aligned to the OS Grid.
Vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15 cm RMSE.
Transformation is specific to the survey time period.
Metadata should be checked for survey date.
Metadata should be checked for product resolution.
A time-stamped survey should be preferred when composite vintage may hide recent terrain change.

promotion_rule: Exact revision 14 runtime output plus remote integrity readback is required before promoting any parcel height-difference value.
